reasons: CS2101 is mutually exclusive with CS2103, CS2113 and CS2103T, so the only compatible software engineering prerequisite is CS2103DE.
CS2103DE is offered only in Sem 2 and needs CS2030S and CS2040 first; earliest CS2103DE is semester 4, then CS3281 semester 6, then CS3213 semester 8.
CS3219 must follow CS3213, but no semester after 8 exists, so the must-take courses and ordering wishes cannot all be met.
